user.title: Add a proxied web service
user.description: Enter the details for the internal web service you want to proxy through Home Assistant. The service only needs to be reachable by HA — not by your browser.

data_description.name: Shown in the sidebar. Also used to generate the URL path (e.g. 'Frigate NVR' → /frigate-nvr).
data_description.server: e.g. http://myservice.internal:8080 — reachable from HA, not from your browser.
data_description.send_ingress_path: Enable for apps that support HA Supervisor's X-Ingress-Path header (e.g. Frigate). Tells the app its base URL so asset and API paths resolve correctly.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the URL and ensure Home Assistant can connect to it.
error.invalid_url: The server URL is not valid.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.
